data.name: CUMANIOK
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "CUMANIOK" — a unique 3D open-world village life and business simulator, packed with local humor and the heartwarming atmosphere of traditional countryside!

You start your journey with a simple, overgrown plot of land, but you have an ambitious goal — to become the most respected "Gospodar" (Master Householder) in the village. In this game, you don't just click buttons; you freely control your character, drive cars, explore the village, and build your estate from scratch.

KEY FEATURES:

Iconic Rural Car Fleet: Forget about expensive supercars! Get behind the wheel of an old-school classic, a legendary and spacious diesel station wagon, or drive to the local village club in a flashy vintage sedan. Start your engine and drive through dirt roads to the local store to buy construction materials!

Idle Village Business: Build greenhouses for juicy tomatoes, set up beehives, manage a chicken coop, and plant vineyards. Set up a market bench by your gates to sell fresh homemade goods to passing tourists and earn steady passive income.

Yard Customization & "Casa Mare":Turn your yard into a masterpiece. Build a traditional sweep well, a cozy wooden gazebo for family gatherings, and construct a beautiful house with a mandatory "Casa Mare" (the grand traditional guest room).

Cozy Village Vacation Vibe: Enjoy relaxing gameplay filled with funny cultural references, authentic traditions, soul-stirring music, and the cozy feeling of spending summer at grandma's house.

Grab your hoe, fuel up your wagon, and show everyone who the real Master of the village is!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
